name: Minetest
tagline: (server) is a near-infinite-world block sandbox game and a game engine, inspired by InfiniMiner, Minecraft, and the like.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/minetest:5.10.0@sha256:781e50480e4027145d2c81f5cbf6632df40ef0a2b5781682cd149ce58bea305e
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CLI_ARGS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 30000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: udp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config/.minetest
        target: /config/.minetest
